title: Identify the top 5 schools with the highest SAT Math scores that are either
question: Identify the top 5 schools with the highest SAT Math scores that are either magnet schools (Magnet = 1) or charter schools (Charter = 1). For each school, return its name, city, phone number, and the percentage of students aged 5–17 eligible for free meals. Only include schools where this percentage is greater than 20%.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s."XCL_047" AS name, s."XCL_050" AS city, s."XCL_058" AS phone, (CAST(f."XCL_025" AS REAL) / f."XCL_024") AS free_meal_pct
FROM satscores AS sat
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON sat."XCL_030" = s."XCL_041"
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
WHERE (s."XCL_077" = 1 OR s."XCL_063" = 1)
  AND (CAST(f."XCL_025" AS REAL) / f."XCL_024") > 0.20
ORDER BY sat."XCL_037" DESC
LIMIT 5
